name: plaud-server-exporter
description: Server-side Plaud.ai exporter: direct internal API client + Playwright auth, writes Obsidian-friendly Markdown.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@plaud-server-exporter/server && npm run typecheck:extension
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run lint:extension && npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm run lint:markdown && npm run verify && npm run verify:extension && npm test && npm run test:extension && node scripts/smoke_container.mjs

_overrides_note: js-yaml: markdownlint-cli2 pins 5.2.1, which is covered by GHSA-pm4m-ph32-ghv5 (high, DoS via exponential flow-collection parsing). Floor is 5.2.2; the caret lets Dependabot keep moving. Drop this once markdownlint-cli2 itself requires >=5.2.2.
